chapter_path_zh: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
content.stem: 对于金融机构的高级管理层而言,哪项关键指标能为其提供有关反洗钱控制措施有效性的最有价值的数据？

options.A: 自动监测系统生成的真阳性与假阳性之比
options.B: 监测名单筛查系统生成的洗钱警报数量
options.C: 每月新引入的高风险客户数量
options.D: 因商业原因退出的客户数量

content.stem_en: Which key metric provides senior management with information about the effectiveness of its AML controls?

options_en.A: The ratio of true positives to false positives generated by the automated monitoring system
options_en.B: The number of money laundering alerts generated by the watchlist screening system
options_en.C: The number of high-risk customers onboarded each month
options_en.D: The number of clients exited for commercial reasons

content.raw_question_en: 单选 -[AML/CFTCompliancePrograms] Which key metric provides senior management information about the effectiveness of its A ML controls? The ratio of true positives to false positives generated by the automated monitoring system. The number of money laundering alerts generated by the watchlist screening system. The number of high-risk customers onboarded each month. The number of clients exited for commercial reasons.
